description:
Connect GitHub with Device Flow. action=start returns verification_uri and user_code: show them to the user, then action=poll with pending_id after they authorize. Tokens go to the encrypted vault and are never returned.
Use when: the user wants to connect or replace the GitHub credential without pasting a token.
Avoid when: you only need public read access, or a token is already configured.
Output: start: verification_uri, user_code, pending_id, expiry. poll: pending | denied | expired | connected.

action.description: start: begin the device flow (returns verification_uri + user_code). poll: check with pending_id whether the user authorized.

pending_id.description: action=poll: opaque id returned by action=start; it does not contain the device code or token.

replace_existing.description: action=start: 1 explicitly authorizes replacing an existing GitHub credential; 0 does not.
